title: Critique: a laptop could share the contingencies of a blind paralyzed person

statements.text: For a person both nearly blind and nearly paralyzed, visual sensorimotor contingencies are so reduced that they could be programmed into a laptop. The theory would then credit the laptop with that person’s experience, yet the person has experience and the laptop has none.

sources.quote: O&N’s thesis would commit them to the claim that the laptop has experiences like those of the legally blind paralytic I mentioned.
